scope: Authenticated publisher v1.2 orderbook ABI consumed by snapshot.py orderbook for bounded read-only observations; no signing, simulation, submission or saved order state.

publisher_evidence.locator: Complete pw ABI literal and LP deployment literal within retained reader prefix; zP applies v1.2 address and hw selects pw.
publisher_evidence.hash_scope: UTF-8 exact complete JavaScript array/object literal including delimiters, excluding variable name and assignment; not complete asset hashes. Full reader asset was truncated and direct request denied. Literals parsed as data only; no downloaded code executed.

interpretation.bids: One charterId-keyed tuple in ABI order: bidder address, count uint256, maxUnitPrice uint256. Preserve named raw fields; bidder is not independently authenticated as current charter owner, an escrow balance or a reserved allocation.
interpretation.fillable: Getter-reported boolean for one charterId at the pinned block; not a simulation result, keeper promise or future execution guarantee.
interpretation.openBidCount: Number reported by openBidCount; order-count context, not remaining licenses or successful purchases. Included in the fixed auctions snapshot as license_open_bid_count.
interpretation.openBids: Unsigned explicit start/count and exact dynamic uint256[] ids decoding; at most 100 requested IDs. Returned IDs retain unestablished identifier semantics and are never automatically passed to charterId-keyed getters. Ordering, stable cursors, FCFS priority and complete coverage are not established.
interpretation.events: Bid lifecycle evidence is supplemental only. Do not add BidFilled consideration to LicensesPurchased totals without transaction-level reconciliation; placement is not execution.

limits: snapshot.py orderbook requires explicit start and count (1..100), accepts at most 10 unique explicit charter_ids, and performs no automatic pagination or joins. Chain, code, bank/registry relationships and unchanged pinned block hash are checked with the snapshot transport and existing byte/time/call bounds.
bids retains bidder, count and maxUnitPrice as typed raw fields. No denomination/decimals scaling, funding, exact fill conditions or payment routing is inferred.
No independent source/bytecode equivalence, escrow semantics, keeper ABI/address, priority enforcement or audit-to-deployment correspondence is established.

One page is bounded partial coverage even when empty or shorter than requested. Selected charter observations are independent of returned page IDs. fillable is a pinned-block getter observation, not future execution assurance.
